variants.headline: Party leader faces a challenge
variants.body: The leader of {party} is being challenged. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.

variants.headline: Leadership becomes a contested question
variants.body: A challenge to the leadership of {party} has opened. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.

variants.headline: A challenge inside the party
variants.body: Leadership of the party {party} is under challenge. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.
